messages:
Priya: Heads-up — sudden squall on the Embarcadero, platforms are soaked and they're doing single-track through Embarcadero station. My 8:05 Caltrain was an 18m delay. Anyone else getting drenched? :umbrella:
Alex: yikes. saw a @CommuteBot alert earlier. BART seems ok but Muni is crawling at F Market. I jumped to an UberPool... not ideal.
CommuteBot: Automated alert: SF SCC Transit — Heavy rain advisory, localized flooding near Embarcadero. Caltrain delays 10–25m. See https://transit.example/status/17698
Sam: Ugh. My bike got puddle-logged. Recommend folks avoid the bike lane near Pier 14 — standing water.
Tanya: I switched to walking + ferry this morning. Ferry had a short delay because of wind but dried me out :) Coffee lines longer though.
Alex: Where's the shortest coffee line? Asking for a soggy coworker. :coffee:
Priya: 2nd floor kitchen has no line but espresso machine squeaks — might be worth it.
Sam: Pro tip: bring an extra pair of socks in your desk drawer. Learned the hard way.
Tanya: Also FYI if you need to get downtown, `30X` express is detouring via Market -> 5th. Took me 12m longer but avoided the floods.
Priya: Thanks for the heads up — I'm going to bring a towel to my desk. If anyone needs a dry hoodie, I have an XL in the office lost+found. :sweat_smile:
Alex: :thumbsup: stay safe y'all. If anything gets worse ping #incidents but for now this is a classic SF micro-storm.
